Name: Zur
Summary: Zur was a prince of Midian and the father of Cozbi, and one of the five Midianite kings slain by Israel.
KeyStory: Zur's daughter was slain with Zimri at Peor, and Zur himself fell to Israel's sword in the war against Midian.
LifeLesson: The gods of Midian could not protect their own princes.
